title: Hearty Japanese Pear Oat Bowl
description: A comforting Japanese-inspired oat bowl with a sweet pear compote and crunchy toppings.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, bring water to a boil.
2. Gradually add the oats and reduce heat to low, stirring frequently.
3. Cook for 5 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the water.
4. In a separate pan, heat honey over low heat until it starts to caramelize.
5. Add diced pear to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes or until slightly tender.
6. In a separate pan, toast almonds over medium heat until lightly browned.
7. In a large bowl, combine cooked oats, pear compote, and toasted almonds.
8. Top with coconut flakes and serve immediately.
